theorems.name: Submission.w12_ball_boundary_layer_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (f : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient f g (ball 0 1) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < 1 → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1 \ ball 0 r, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * Real.sqrt (1 - r)) * ((∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ 2) + ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖g x‖ₑ ^ 2)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
